limits.description: Hermes attribution comes from Lilly 1647; original ancient text and Lilly interpolations not independently collated.
Historical herb names, glyphs and original unusual spellings require text-specific witnesses; no fabricated modern plant IDs.
Conception/birth and first decumbiture are distinct chart contexts.
Daily Moon light and speed are not interchangeable; exact computations and calendar conversions unspecified here.
Compact conjunction, exception and local paragraph scopes remain qualified; record existence or tests cannot certify that every intended Boolean interpretation is resolved.
Claims of nine, ten, fourteen, twenty and thirty days lack individual verified outcomes.
Historic medicine lists include white lead and other potentially toxic substances; efficacy and safety unproven.
Bloodletting, emetics and purging are documented history only, not treatment advice.
Mars/Scorpio source insinuates moral or sexual guilt without evidence; never use as factual inference.
Some illness cause, affected planet and cure polarity statements are internally hard to reconcile.
Several Mars sign rows have individual additional lunar light, motion or other restrictions.
First-person experience reports have no patient counts, controls or independent follow-up.
No complete source-independent replication or empirical predictive validation.
Original source pages are retained externally; evidence rasters are locating images, not a diplomatic transcription.
PDF306 attributes certain fevers/lung illness to Saturn/Mercury and recommends cooling; PDF307 recommends heating/softening for Saturn/Mercury origins. Preserve both; intention unresolved.
Scorpio/Saturn PDF310 explicitly says no retention of Urine. Draft polarity repaired; modern physiological interpretation remains unspecified.
PDF312 visible page label appears279 though sequence278; PDF313 label is partially printed/damaged, appearing29 at sequence279. Original PDF numbers are primary locators.
Cooling list has uncertain lexical readings; do not join separate printed rows or substitute confident modern plant identities.
Moon decreasing motion and Moon slow motion are distinct local expressions. No numerical threshold or universal equivalence is supplied in these pages.
Mars/Aquarius combines a first-square/opposition condition with present remedy after twenty days; geometry and calendar language remain unreconciled.
Symptoms, first-person experience and authorial confidence are preserved as claims; no patient denominator or independent outcome verification is supplied.
